'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Tom Haid LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Haid]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Atrocious Training'''. Username '''Xanth'''. LS only (hub DS —). L5 Redemption struck → Quite A Mercenary (sheet Quik/Quite ~ Merc). Additional on sheet (not in 60): Great Warrior; A Jedi's Strength; Domain Of Evil; Size Matters Not; It Is The Future You See; You Must Confront Vader.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Xanth
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
